programs.name: robust_weekly_backtest
programs.description: Use for daily series with a recurring seven-day profile, isolated extreme observations, and poor performance from tail-trend extrapolation. It backtests seasonal-naive, robust phase, trimmed-phase, shrinkage, and level-adjusted forecasts before selecting or narrowly ensembling them.
programs.assumption: Across three historical 14-day rolling holdouts, at least one weekly candidate has mean SMAPE below 45.0, improving on the parent's 51.4676 mean SMAPE, and its worst fold is below the parent's 62.6241 worst fold.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if every weekly candidate has validation SMAPE of 45.0 or more, if the next 56 observations cease sharing the historical seven-day phase pattern, or if a persistent level shift exceeds the level adjustment cap of 25%.

programs.name: seasonal_analog_median
programs.description: Use when the recurring weekly shape appears in multiple historical regimes but its amplitude and local sequence vary. It finds prior normalized tail patterns, shifts their subsequent trajectories to the current level, and robustly combines their continuations.
programs.assumption: For some tail length in {7, 14, 21} and neighbor count in {3, 5, 8}, three historical 14-day holdouts produce mean SMAPE below 46.0 and at least 5.0 percentage points below the parent's 51.4676 mean SMAPE.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when no historical segment has a comparable normalized tail, when rolling analog SMAPE is 46.0 or more, or when the forecast horizon enters a regime absent from all eligible historical continuations.
